title: XAS allocation steering override
description: The typed object a planner's natural language compiles to (§6). The prompt moves weights and pins; it NEVER edits solver code. Same inputs + same override => byte-identical plan. A ledger entry wraps one of these.

pins.description: Instruction-driven pins. 'defer' unpins an order and forbids arrivals before not_before.

order.description: Real order_id (resolved from NL by the agent).

boosts.description: Multiplicative weight bumps on W(o) for a customer's orders.

customer.description: customer_id (resolved from a dealer name, e.g. 'Colmobil' -> CUST-001).

forbid.description: Hard 'do not move' — pins an order to its incumbent week.

lambda.description: Changed-week step penalty for this solve. If null/absent, the λ sweep default applies.

ttl.description: Optional expiry as a week label; the entry is skipped on replay once the current week passes it, so a one-off nudge doesn't linger.
